item.title: Italy Proposes Accelerating Tobacco, Nicotine Tax Increases
item.description: Italy is proposing to bring forward scheduled tax increases on cigarettes, heated tobacco products and e-cigarettes by six months, from January 2028 to July 2027. (Published on November 26, 2026bytobaccoreporter.com)

item.title: Indonesia Edges Closer to a Total Vape Ban
item.description: Indonesia is facing renewed calls for a nationwide vaping ban after the Indonesian Ulema Council declared e-cigarettes prohibited under Islamic law, citing health concerns and their potential use to consume illegal drugs. (Published on November 27, 2026byecigclick.co.uk)
